target: 遊戲開始時為玩家載入預設

source: Enable to disable all hotkeys added by Project Proteus.\nDefault: false
target: 啟用後，停用 Project Proteus 新增的所有快捷鍵。\n預設：關閉

source: Enable to have green explosion emit from player character upon changing appearance.\nDefault: true
target: 啟用後，玩家角色變更外觀時會產生綠色爆炸效果。\n預設：開啟

source: Enable to have Proteus Spawns load perks from the associated player character.\nDefault: true
target: 啟用後，PROTEUS 生成角色會載入所屬玩家角色的天賦。\n預設：開啟

source: Enable to have Proteus Spawns load spells from the associated player character.\nDefault: true
target: 啟用後，PROTEUS 生成角色會載入所屬玩家角色的法術。\n預設：開啟

source: Enable to have preset load on player at game start. Prevents appearance issues.\nDefault: true
target: 啟用後，遊戲開始時會為玩家載入預設，以避免外觀問題。\n預設：開啟

source: Enable to have create RaceMenu appearance backups each time you save your character into PROTEUS.\nDefault: false
target: 啟用後，每次將角色儲存至 PROTEUS 時，都會建立 RaceMenu 外觀備份。\n預設：關閉

source: Enable to take full advantage of Proteus alternative death system.\nDefault: false
target: 啟用後，可完整使用 PROTEUS 替代死亡系統。\n預設：關閉
